name: dopadone
description: Work on one task from the DopaDone CLI and keep Codex aware of the current local date and time. Health-rhythm reminders remain Claude-specific.

interface.shortDescription: One-task workflow plus local time awareness
interface.longDescription: Shared task workflow for Claude Code and Codex. Codex also receives a small local date/time marker on eligible prompts. Habit reminders, sleep enforcement, wrap-up nudges, and desktop notifications remain Claude-specific.
defaultPrompt: Pick one task and help me make progress.
